profile.headline: Senior Android Developer at Insulet Corporation
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Work on the Android application for the Omnipod 5 insulin pump. Developed new features and improve the support and compatibility with new CGM sensors.

positions.title: Senior Android Developer
positions.description: Develop the android application for the Omnipod Dash insulin pump. Maintenance and fix bugs in our custom version of Android OS. Fixed bugs for the Omnipod OP5 insulin pump. Develop tools for the development team. Fixed issues from production devices with multiple teams(Cloud, Systems). Train new team members and interview candidates.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Design and development of the android applications for Vistana and 2 other companies. Development of the applications from the start. Lead a team of 4 android developers. Attend wire frame design meetings to analyse the scope of new features, UI and guidelines design meetings. Release and manage the apps on the Google Play store and Amazon app store. Interview candidates for positions in the team. Start the app migration from Java to Kotlin. Start implementation of the new Android Architecture Components(LiveData, ViewModel, Room).

positions.title: Software Engineering Associate Manager
positions.description:
Android developer for an app that handles ticket sales, resort reservation, waiting lines for different amusement parks in Orlando, Florida. 
Worked in new features, maintenance and UI redesign for this app. 
Also developed new features in shared libraries used in multiple apps. 
Interview candidates for open positions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Associate Manager
positions.description:
Android developer for an app that handles ticket sales, resort reservation, waiting lines for different amusement parks in Orlando, Florida. 
Worked in new features, sustainment and UI redesign for this app. 
Also developed new features in shared libraries used in multiple apps. 
Interview candidates for open positions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android development and maintenance of a banking application.
Contributed to other teams development.
Dev leader of the team in Mexico.
Conducted training on Android development.

positions.title: Software Engineer SR
positions.description: Develop and support the android app and the mobile site for a car insurance company, using javascript, html5, ajax.

positions.title: Software SR Engineer
positions.description: Develop, implement and debug cross-platform Java, Perl, and  C/C++software running on Windows/Linux workstations, and Java-based software running on Android embedded operating systems. This software automates component and product testing of reference software running on OMAP reference platforms.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Develop, debugging and optimizing games for several platforms such as java 2me, Brew, BlackBerry and Android OS.
